strata_specifics.ground_texture: Fine-grained yellowish-orange fluvial sandstone and mottled red claystone paths

layer_3_action.subject: Gigantoraptor
features: small decorative bone crest on top of the skull
vibrant blue skin patches around large calm yellow eyes
exceptionally long slender bird-like running legs
three-fingered hands with large sharp black talons
short tail tipped with a clean sculpted fan of feathers
smooth matte dusty ochre and terracotta clay body plumage with navy-blue accent feathers on the forearms
layer_3_action.action: A majestic, non-aggressive Gigantoraptor with clean high-poly clay geometry is standing calmly in a graceful, upright posture among the yellowish-orange sand channels of a braided river system. The camera frames a balanced three-quarter profile at a neutral eye-level view, dramatically showcasing its massive, bird-like running silhouette and parrot-like head without any cartoonish over-rounding or frightening territorial displays. It is tilting its head down with a quiet, curious look toward a small patch of low cretaceous ground shrubs, under soft studio ambient occlusion lighting. No text.
